description.value: You draw a little attention to yourself to take the pressure off of another. You [[/act create-a-diversion]], and the benefits of a successful check apply to up to two members of your crop instead of you. The effects of a success last for each target until the end of their next turn, and can end early based on each target's actions. You don't need to be observing those members of your crop, but you need to know they are within 60 feet of you to choose them.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
